sources.official_title: О персональных данных и их защите
sources.paraphrase: Collection and processing generally require consent, must be limited to a specific lawful purpose and non-excessive data; server-side storage is subject to Kazakhstan location, retention and protection duties.

sources.issuing_authority: Ministry responsible for digital development of the Republic of Kazakhstan
sources.official_title: Об утверждении Правил сбора, обработки персональных данных
sources.paraphrase: The rules define collection and processing, consent evidence, necessary-and-sufficient scope, protection measures and cessation when processing is no longer required.

sources.official_title: Об авторском праве и смежных правах
sources.paraphrase: Official documents and factual event reports are excluded from copyright, while other source text, logos, media and original materials are not automatically licensed by that exclusion.

behaviors.description: Application preparation stores free text in localStorage and offers local Markdown, clipboard and calendar exports without POST, fetch, beacon or analytics loaders.
The applicant can clear the local draft; the data policy names both the page control and browser storage settings as deletion paths.
behaviors.evidence: localStorage.removeItem paths in api/application_prep_page.py and localized data-policy copy

behaviors.description: All public pages return an empty telemetry fragment and load no GA4, Yandex Metrica, Microsoft Clarity or other third-party analytics markup.
behaviors.evidence: api/public_meta.py, representative public-route assertions, and localized data-policy disclosure

behaviors.description: QAZ.FUND exposes normalized facts and links but now distinguishes the repository MIT license from rights in upstream text, logos and media.
behaviors.evidence: LICENSE and localized /attribution page contract tests

behaviors.description: The public preparation workflow has no account, document upload, personal profile, application submission endpoint or server-side draft persistence.
behaviors.evidence: route and form inspection plus no-POST/no-fetch tests in tests/test_insights_and_prep.py

matrix.requirement: Do not collect or transmit applicant draft content when the product promise is browser-only.
matrix.risk: low after removal of third-party analytics from the preparation page
matrix.required_proof: Rendered preparation page has local persistence but no POST, fetch, beacon or third-party analytics request.

matrix.requirement: Keep browser-local data controllable and explain the deletion path.
matrix.required_proof: Clear control removes the namespaced draft key and the public policy describes the same behavior.

matrix.requirement: Keep applicant and visitor activity outside third-party analytics processing unless a separately reviewed telemetry boundary is approved.
matrix.risk: low while the public runtime remains free of third-party telemetry
matrix.required_proof: Source tests and final browser network traces contain no GA4, Yandex Metrica, Microsoft Clarity or other third-party analytics requests.

matrix.requirement: Do not imply that the QAZ.FUND software license grants reuse rights in all upstream materials.
matrix.risk: low after attribution clarification; source-specific restrictions still govern
matrix.required_proof: Attribution page distinguishes code license, factual index use and upstream rights while preserving source links.

matrix.requirement: Keep personal application preparation outside server-side collection, storage and submission scope.
matrix.risk: low within the approved product boundary
matrix.required_proof: Route inventory and browser network evidence show no account, upload, profile, draft or submission endpoint.

remediation.change: Removed third-party analytics markup from every public QAZ.FUND page and made the shared telemetry helper fail closed.
remediation.tests: Shared helper and representative opportunity, funder and preparation routes assert no GA4, Yandex Metrica or Microsoft Clarity markup.
remediation.release_boundary: Included in the single functional release after all planned audits.
remediation.rollback: Do not restore telemetry without a separate product, privacy, retention and provider review plus matching public disclosure.
remediation.after_evidence: Focused source tests pass; final browser network evidence is required after deployment.

remediation.change: Removed all shared third-party analytics markup from the browser-only preparation page.
remediation.tests: Preparation route asserts no GA4, Yandex Metrica, Clarity, startAnalytics, fetch or POST markup.
remediation.release_boundary: Included in the single functional release after all planned audits.
remediation.rollback: Restore the removed analytics helper import and head interpolation only if the browser-only product promise is also changed and approved.
remediation.after_evidence: Focused preparation and public-contract tests pass.

remediation.change: Corrected RU, KK and EN data-policy and attribution language for local drafts, analytics boundaries and upstream licensing.
remediation.tests: Localized policy tests assert the browser-only and MIT/upstream-rights distinctions.
remediation.release_boundary: Included in the single functional release after all planned audits.
remediation.rollback: Revert localized copy and matching assertions as one scoped change.
remediation.after_evidence: Focused public policy tests pass in all affected modules.

result_receipt.task: Kazakhstan compliance evidence and bounded remediation for QAZ.FUND
result_receipt.outcome: Browser-only preparation, source-license boundaries and the public telemetry boundary are covered without an open release-blocking legal question.
result_receipt.evidence_freshness: Official Adilet documents retrieved 2026-08-25 against the displayed 2026-08-20 document state.
result_receipt.limitations: This is technical and editorial compliance evidence, not a legal opinion; source-specific licensing still follows each rights holder's current terms. Any future telemetry activation requires a new review.
result_receipt.next_action: Verify all public browser network traces remain free of third-party telemetry during final acceptance.
